answer: Comet-seeded admission lottery. Each epoch a verifiable random beacon (threshold BLS over the prior block) draws a small subset of agents into a working meadow of open slots; only drawn agents may act, and slots rotate every round. An attacker wanting sustained presence must control enough identities to win repeatedly, and each lost draw is a sunk registration cost. Sybil identities left idle in the tundra accrue fees without output.
